title: Point editor
blurb: Interactive vector point editor that normalizes imported SVG paths with getPathData({ normalize: true }), exposes draggable and keyboard-operable handles, and writes every edit back via setPathData().
question: Can an interactive SVG editor normalize arbitrary input shapes, edit anchor and cubic control handles with pointer or keyboard, and rely on setPathData() for d-string serialization?
result: Normalizing on import eliminates custom d-string parsing; mutating segment coordinates and calling setPathData() round-trips cleanly through the browser's serializer (verified behind flag in Chrome 153; not verified in Chrome 160).
testedIn: Chrome 153 behind --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI; not verified in Chrome 160
